name: doers-3d-website-creator
description: Create detailed design and implementation plans for responsive, interactive 3D websites, from site research and scene direction through preview integrity and visual QA.

interface.longDescription: Plan immersive 3D websites from a brief, reference site, or existing project. Map distinct scenes for each page, choose a visual direction, plan camera motion and interactions, and define practical architecture. Includes studio and portfolio concepts, cinematic home and interior journeys, truthful live-preview and data guidance, responsive accessibility, complete 2D fallbacks, and route-by-route visual QA. This skills-only plugin provides instructions and prompts; it does not host, fetch, monitor, or deploy a website by itself.
defaultPrompt: Plan a 3D website for my brand, with a page-by-page scene and interaction map.
Write a photorealistic 3D website brief for my project without inventing its facts.
Review my 3D website for mobile behavior, accessibility, performance, and fallback.

review.commerce_description: The plugin provides website design instructions and text only. It does not sell products or services, accept payments, process purchases, or run transactions.

publication.release_notes: Update display name to 3D Website Creator.
